propositions: Step-budget exhaustion raises LLMRunnerError which does not match the UnretryableOutputError catch clause in CompletionAgentStep.run, preventing bounded recovery from engaging
LLMBudgetExhaustedError must be introduced as a typed subclass of LLMRunnerError to make budget exhaustion identifiable by type rather than diagnostic shape sniffing
CompletionAgentStep.run must extend its exception handler to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to the existing _recover mechanism
Budget diagnostic must be preserved on self.failure_diagnostic before recovery so counters survive if recovery also fails
Backward compatibility is maintained because existing except LLMRunnerError and except LLMError sites continue to catch the new subclass
Recovery fail-closed guarantees remain untouched; the change only adds the missing entry edge for budget exhaustion to reach recovery
